items.title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Shin Oishinbo' Announced
items.summary: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo, announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Voice actors Kenji Yamauchi (Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai) and Ken Uo (Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de) are joining the anime as Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama, respectively. Kenichi Nishida (Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei) is directing the anime at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment. Takahiro Nagano (Tensei shitara Ken deshita) is handling the series composition, while Nozomi Kawashige (Deatte 5-byou de Battle) is designing the characters. Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki. Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010. Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992. Source: Official Site

items.title: Performers announced for matsuri ’26: Japanese Music Experience LONDON

British fans can look forward to a fantastic evening show from hitsujibungaku, Kyary Pamyu Pamyu and Otoboke Beaver! The Music Way Project is a collaboration between the Culture and Entertainment Industry Promotion Association (CEIPA) and the Toyota Group, with an aim of bringing Japanese music overseas. After successful shows in the US and Thailand, the project is now coming to Europe for the first time with a one-off performance in London’s Outernet Live on Monday 14th December 2026. matsuri ’26 will take place at the Outernet Live, on the first floor of the Outernet building near Tottenham Court Road station in central London (WC2H 8LH). The show is scheduled to open its doors at 19:00, with the venue’s curfew at 23:00. The stage order for the three performers has not been announced. hitsujibungaku (羊文学) are an alternative rock band fronted by Moeka Shiozuka (Vocals, Guitar) and Yurika Kawanishi (Bass). items.summary: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara (Getting Shots on Frying Pan) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video. Produced by J.C.Staff, the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027. Voice actors Shuu Uchida (Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu) and Masaaki Mizunaka (Nyaight of the Living Cat) are voicing the beautiful girl and male versions of Juntarou Aoki, respectively. Staff Director: Masahiro Hiraoka (Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière) Series Composition, Script: Susumu Yamakawa (Maiko-san Chi no Makanai-san) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Natsuki Ooyama (Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!)) Music: Yoshihide Ootomo (Inu-Ou) Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami (Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo) Aoki began serializing the slice of life manga, with illustrations by Moriyama, on Comic Newtype website in May 2021. Kadokawa published the fifth volume in October 2024. A spin-off series titled Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara Transit featuring Hirota Takahara, began serializing on March 20. The story combines the romantic pursuits of the protagonists, Taiki and Chinatsu, with the passion of spokon , and the adventure of growing up from adolescence. While the Blue Box manga officially ended on July 13 , we can still follow our favorite characters in the anime adaptation currently airing. Blue Box Season 2 explores new sides of the cast and introduces the long awaited Yumeka Goto, a person from Chinatsu’s past.
